summary: School urges FCC to preserve E-Rate funding to maintain internet infrastructure and services for students and staff.

claims.argument: Without this funding, schools would have to cut costs on internet speed and equipment
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, we would have to look at cutting costs on things such as our internet speed, what network components we will have to keep even if they are no longer getting security patches, we will have to go with consumer grade solutions instead of small and medium business type equipment due to the ever increasing costs of technology these past couple years.

filer_raw: VINCENT MOHR | DE LA SALLE NORTH CATHOLIC HIGH SCHOOL
